import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, types
from pathlib import Path
from PySide6.QtCore import QCoreApplication, QEvent, QEventLoop, QTimer
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMessageBox
from tests.ui.test_analysis_sources import _package
from tests.analysis.test_numeric_cli_receiving import retained_files
from capture_desktop.state import CaptureState

variant = sys.argv[1]
source = Path.cwd()
screen_path = "desktop/capture_desktop/screen_analysis.py"
if variant == "parent":
    code = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "2f4dcf3:" + screen_path], text=True)
    module = types.ModuleType("capture_desktop.receiving_parent_screen")
    module.__package__ = "capture_desktop"
    exec(compile(code, "<exact 2f4dcf3 screen_analysis.py>", "exec"), module.__dict__)
    Screen = module.AnalysisScreen
else:
    code = (source / screen_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    from capture_desktop.screen_analysis import AnalysisScreen as Screen

started = time.monotonic()
record = {
    "variant": variant, "screen_sha256": hashlib.sha256(code.encode()).hexdigest(),
    "current_git_head": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
    "wait": "real QEventLoop.exec", "events": [], "warnings": [],
}
temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="source-qt-loop-" + variant + "-",
                                       dir="/dev/shm/capturesuite-234cae4aee53")
root = Path(temporary.name)
for key in ("LOCALAPPDATA", "APPDATA", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "XDG_DATA_HOME", "XDG_CACHE_HOME"):
    folder = root / key
    folder.mkdir()
    os.environ[key] = str(folder)
app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(False)
package = _package(root / "loop.mmsession")
before = retained_files(package)
screen = Screen(CaptureState())
screen.set_package(str(package))
screen._command.setCurrentIndex(screen._command.findData("features"))
screen.resize(1200, 900)
screen.show()
app.processEvents()
loop = QEventLoop()

def event(name):
    record["events"].append({"event": name, "seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
                             "ui_completion_already_applied": bool(screen._last_job_dir)})

def watch():
    dialog = QApplication.activeModalWidget()
    if isinstance(dialog, QMessageBox):
        record["warnings"].append(dialog.text())
        dialog.accept()

timer = QTimer()
timer.timeout.connect(watch)
timer.start(50)
screen._start_job()
thread = screen._thread
worker = screen._worker
assert thread is not None and worker is not None
worker.finished.connect(lambda result: event("worker.finished observed"))
worker.failed.connect(lambda text: event("worker.failed observed: " + text))
thread.finished.connect(lambda: event("thread.finished observed"))
thread.finished.connect(loop.quit)
QTimer.singleShot(45_000, loop.quit)
loop.exec()
app.processEvents()
record.update(last_job_dir=screen._last_job_dir, ui_thread_cleared=screen._thread is None,
              ui_log=screen._log.toPlainText(), raw_unchanged=before == retained_files(package),
              raw_before=before, raw_after=retained_files(package))
normal = screen._thread is None
record["normal_completion"] = normal
if not normal:
    event("normal wait timed out; explicit quit requested for cleanup only")
    thread.quit()
    QTimer.singleShot(3_000, loop.quit)
    loop.exec()
    app.processEvents()
    record["cleared_after_explicit_quit"] = screen._thread is None
record["seconds"] = time.monotonic() - started
print("RECEIPT=" + json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
if screen._thread is not None:
    os._exit(4)
timer.stop()
screen.close()
screen.deleteLater()
QCoreApplication.sendPostedEvents(None, QEvent.Type.DeferredDelete)
app.processEvents()
temporary.cleanup()
sys.exit(0 if normal else 3)
